_comment: Code handling for scripts/npshistory_audit.py. NPSHistory URLs are DISCOVERED from npshistory.com's own park index (home-page <select> + park_histories.htm anchors), then by park-name match; this file only covers what discovery cannot. 'no_page' = MPH codes that are NPS administrative/regional units with no park archive on NPSHistory.com. 'umbrella' = codes that appear first in composite MPH codes (e.g. 'NAMA,LINC') but are the parent unit; primary_code() skips them so the entry maps to the specific site. 'non_nps' = FWS/BLM codes (no NPSHistory park page; FWS/BLM general collections exist but are not per-site).

name_hints._comment: Optional: MPH code -> exact NPSHistory park name when automatic name matching fails. Filled by hand after a run reports 'unresolved'.
